query:
select
  (select schedule from cron.job where jobname = 'survival-checkpoint') as cron_schedule,
  (select command from cron.job where jobname = 'survival-checkpoint') as cron_command,
  (select array_agg(v) from (select status as v from public.posts group by status) x) as post_statuses,
  (select count(*) from public.posts where status in ('trial','incomplete')) as active_posts;
